fact: The Plan National de Développement Sanitaire 2020-2024 places the Système National d'Information Sanitaire under the responsibility of the ministry's Direction de l'Information Sanitaire, says the SNIS then held its data in Excel and the ESOPE software, sets as a priority action implementing DHIS2 across the whole national territory, and budgets 435,193,066 FDJ (1% of the plan) for the strategic pillar on a strengthened SNIS.
title: Plan National de Développement Sanitaire 2020 – 2024
publisher: Ministère de la Santé, République de Djibouti
